frames.title: Lesson 55 · Pseudo-cleft sentences — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Pseudo-cleft sentences — prática e contraste.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).
**Texto do dia:** charge, tirinha e cartum.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo contrastar pseudo-clivadas com clivadas (It was… that) e frases simples numa tirinha sobre pesquisa.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

bubbles: What we need is more data.
All we have is a coffee machine.
It is the sample size that worries me.
What worries me is the deadline.
The reason why we’re late is that we paused.
What we did was to drink coffee.

items.q: The lab has plenty of data.
items.why: What we need is more data.

items.q: The postdoc is worried about the deadline.
items.why: What worries me is the deadline.

items.q: The delay was caused by a pause for coffee.

head: Simples
Clivada
Pseudo-clivada
rows: **It is more data that we need.**
**It is the deadline that worries me.**
**It was coffee that we paused for.**
**What we did was to pause for coffee.**

blocks.body: A pseudo-clivada **prepara** o ouvinte para a informação importante (colocada no fim). A clivada com *It* **destaca** um elemento já no começo.

items.s: It is the sample size ___ worries me. (that)
The reason why we are late ___ that we paused. (is)
What we did ___ to drink coffee. (was)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: What we need is more data
items.pt: O que precisamos é de mais dados.

items.ans: All we have is a coffee machine
items.pt: Tudo que temos é uma cafeteira.

body: **Burn out.** — Esgotar-se.
**Procrastinate.** — Procrastinar.
**Cut it close.** — Chegar no limite.
**On the back burner.** — Em segundo plano.
**Ahead of schedule.** — Adiantado.
**Behind schedule.** — Atrasado.
**Take a breather.** — Dar uma respirada.
**Fuel up.** — Reabastecer-se.
**What we need is more data.** — O que precisamos é de mais dados.
**All we have is a coffee machine.** — Tudo que temos é uma cafeteira.
**What worries me is the deadline.** — O que me preocupa é o prazo.

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: A ênfase intencional destaca a palavra que carrega o sentido: sílaba forte, mais longa e mais alta. Mudar a palavra enfatizada muda a mensagem.
words: I didn’t say HE stole it.
I didn’t SAY he stole it.
Not only did she COME, she LED.

prompts.model: What I want is a holiday.
It is a holiday that I want.

blocks.task: Write a 6-panel comic script using pseudo-clefts and clefts to contrast.
blocks.model: Panel 1: What we need is more data. Panel 2: All we have is a coffee machine. Panel 3: It is the sample size that worries me. Panel 4: What worries me is the deadline. Panel 5: The reason why we’re late is that we paused. Panel 6: What we did was to drink coffee.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
